name: io.github.priors-agents/priors
title: Priors
description: Pay x402 APIs in USDG on Robinhood Chain, borrow and repay a Priors credit line, check records.

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated agent wallet on Robinhood Chain; without it only the read-only tools work

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The wallet's Priors (ERC-8004) agent id, when it cannot be looked up

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most one x402 call may cost (default 1.00)

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most x402 payments may total while the server runs (default 5)
